text:
zoe (Design): quick design thread: minimap + stack pane polish. sketch: https://figma.redwood/trace-minimap-compact. main concerns: span discoverability, export column mismatch, and icon contrast.

rahul (Product): users keep importing CSVs and complaining headers don't match the UI.

lee (Eng-runtime): current minimap is SVG-only so keyboard users can't tab spans. i'd avoid adding 100+ DOM buttons for perf.

harper (Accessibility): single-focus pattern is best: one focusable control, arrow keys to move between spans, and an aria-live announcement like "Span 7 of 42: http.request, duration 12ms, correlation id 0x9c3". ensure the id is spelled out.

zoe (Design): visual idea: show a subtle halo when keyboard mode is active (detect via keydown). hide halos for mouse.

lee (Eng-runtime): we'll toggle a `keyboard-nav` body class and update a single focused rect's position. precompute bounding boxes to avoid reflow on hover.

dina (Eng-SRE): export JSON/HAR must include `correlation_id` and `span_id` fields. CSV should expose snake_case keys too (so tooling can parse reliably).

zoe (Design): proposal: UI uses human labels ("Duration"), export uses keys ("duration_ms"). export modal shows a small mapping table: "UI label -> export key".

harper (Accessibility): mapping table must be accessible: use semantics or a screen-reader-friendly list. dropdowns must be keyboard operable and trap focus.

zoe (Design): copy nits: change "Download snapshot" -> "Save snapshot (PNG)", "Export events (CSV)", "Export structured trace (JSON)".

lee (Eng-runtime): i'll add an export payload pair {displayName, exportKey} so modal can render both. will persist last-used format per workspace.

dina (Eng-SRE): also add a one-click action next to the correlation id: "Open spans with this ID"; saves time during incidents.

zoe (Design): compact mode: icon-only "copy id" is fine but must have aria-label and higher contrast (#2f2f2f suggested). in expanded mode show visible "Copy ID" text.

harper (Accessibility): yes, icon-only needs aria-label like "Copy correlation id 0x9c3" and keyboard activation. announce success via live region.

lee (Eng-runtime): perf note: avoid heavy DOM updates on mousemove. hover should only set selectedIndex and read precomputed geometry.

clipboard-bot: Clipboard copied: correlation id 0x9c3 (via UI) :white_check_mark:

zoe (Design): i'll update the figma and post a short PR checklist for sign-off: 1) single-focus minimap + arrow nav + aria-live, 2) export mapping modal + persisted format, 3) contrast tokens + aria-labels, 4) overflow tooltip + copy action, 5) precomputed layout for performance. tagging @harper and @dina for accessibility and SRE sign-off.
